use_case_summary: BlueMarrow wants embeddings for nearline route lookup (latency target <200ms), reranking of candidate routes for last-mile delivery (throughput 50 qps), and a support chatbot for drivers. High availability required during peak windows. Cost-sensitive — target TCO < $10k/mo for production embedding index serving; current POC projections exceed that by 3–4x.
technical_observations: POC model: open-llama-medium quantized 8-bit gave acceptable quality but token count with verbose driver logs inflated cost.
KV/prefix caching reduced tokens by ~30% in do-not-opt path; more aggressive prefix caching could drop token burn to target.
Dedicated reserved GPUs reduce per-token inference but commit size (4 GPU equivalent) still > budget for mid-market customer.
Private deployment would satisfy security but procurement timeline & infra ops ownership are blockers.
